assertions.name: at the trace level pn is ABOVE the midpoint — no obstruction there
in the corpus's h-grading the obstruction is type two (-1/2) and the first escape is type FOUR (+1/24)
delta = O(hbar^3), so the pn offset is the exact midpoint to order hbar^2
the obstruction is ORDER TWO, with coefficient exactly -2
the first order at which pn sits ABOVE the midpoint is FIVE, coefficient 4/3
the obstruction is NOT uniform across the tower — several graded pieces are positive, so no all-orders convexity theorem exists
the hbar-expansion reproduces the independently measured 200-bit Delta
the largest positive graded term is below 1e-3 of the leading negative one, so any resummed observable inherits the obstruction unchanged

description: Lifting the pn-midpoint obstruction into the tower. With q = exp(hbar), the hbar-expansion is the Vassiliev/phi_q grading. Delta = L_pn - (L_pp+L_nn)/2 expands as -2 hbar^2 + (4/3) hbar^5 - (59/45) hbar^6 + ..., with orders 0, 1, 3, 4 vanishing. The obstruction is order two; the first order putting pn ABOVE the midpoint is five, and orders 5, 8, 10, 12, 13 are positive, so no all-orders convexity theorem exists and the order-zero result cannot be promoted to one. The series summed at hbar_0 = log(q0) reproduces the independently computed 200-bit Delta to 9 digits. But the largest positive term is 7.6e-4 of the leading negative one, so any resummed observable inherits the obstruction unchanged: the escape is formal, available only to a reading that takes a single graded piece as physical. The corpus has exactly one such reading, vassiliev-filtration-mass-tower's LP/SDP cost-vector basis (independent linear programs per type), and the escape is reachable there and nowhere else. Also: the corpus grades in h = q - 1/q, not log q, and in that variable the first escape is type 4 (+1/24), not 5; at the TRACE level the filtration actually grades, pn is ABOVE the midpoint from h^4 on, so the obstruction is created by taking -log. Bean qou-oooq.
caveats: Reports both gradings. The corpus's is h = q - 1/q; hbar = log q is included only to show that 'which order' is not grading-independent (first escape 5 in hbar, type 4 in h).
Shows only that the SIGN obstruction is absent at type 4. No claim that a type-4 LP produces a valley of stability, an asymmetry energy, or any binding number at all.
Says nothing about qou-bygw's ordering ambiguity, the valley of stability, or A >= 3; those inherit whatever the bond constants do.
